title: Cost allocation tags: splitting the bill

kcs.statement: Cost allocation tags are key-value tags that must be activated in the Billing and Cost Management console before they appear as a dimension in cost reports; activation normally affects subsequent reporting, but management-account users can request up to 12 months of backfill for periods when the resource already carried the tag.

There are two kinds of cost allocation tags, AWS-generated tags (such as aws:createdBy) and user-defined tags (such as Project=checkout), and they are used to split one bill by team, project or environment.
